record.field: SELECT cl.create_date AS x_data_creazione, DATE_TRUNC('month', cl.create_date) AS x_mese, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM cl.create_date)::integer AS x_anno, cl.name AS x_nome, -- jsonb (translatable) → estraggo con fallback it_IT → en_US COALESCE(cs.name->>'it_IT', cs.name->>'en_US') AS x_fase, cs.is_won AS x_vinto, cl.active AS x_attivo, CASE WHEN cl.active = false AND cs.is_won = false THEN 'Perso' WHEN cs.is_won = true THEN 'Vinto' WHEN cl.active = true THEN 'In corso' ELSE 'Altro' END AS x_stato_lead, COALESCE(clr.name->>'it_IT', clr.name->>'en_US') AS x_motivo_perdita, CASE WHEN clr.id IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(clr.name->>'it_IT', clr.name->>'en_US') WHEN cl.active = false THEN 'Non specificato' ELSE NULL END AS x_motivo_perdita_dettaglio, CASE WHEN cs.is_won = true THEN 'Lavorabile' WHEN cl.active = false AND COALESCE(clr.name->>'it_IT', clr.name->>'en_US') ILIKE '%non lavorabile%' THEN 'Non lavorabile' WHEN cl.active = false AND COALESCE(clr.name->>'it_IT', clr.name->>'en_US') ILIKE '%inutile%' THEN 'Non lavorabile' WHEN cl.active = false AND COALESCE(clr.name->>'it_IT', clr.name->>'en_US') ILIKE '%duplicat%' THEN 'Non lavorabile' WHEN cl.active = false AND COALESCE(clr.name->>'it_IT', clr.name->>'en_US') ILIKE '%spam%' THEN 'Non lavorabile' WHEN cl.active = true THEN 'In lavorazione' ELSE 'Da verificare' END AS x_lavorabilita, us.name AS x_origine, uc.name AS x_campagna, COALESCE(st.name->>'it_IT', st.name->>'en_US') AS x_team, rp.name AS x_venditore, cl.expected_revenue AS x_ricavo_atteso, 1 AS x_conteggio FROM crm_lead cl LEFT JOIN crm_stage cs ON cs.id = cl.stage_id LEFT JOIN crm_lost_reason clr ON clr.id = cl.lost_reason_id LEFT JOIN utm_source us ON us.id = cl.source_id LEFT JOIN utm_campaign uc ON uc.id = cl.campaign_id LEFT JOIN crm_team st ON st.id = cl.team_id LEFT JOIN res_users ru ON ru.id = cl.user_id LEFT JOIN res_partner rp ON rp.id = ru.partner_id WHERE cl.type = 'opportunity'

WITH OrdFatt AS ( -- Ordinato e fatturato reale per opportunità, da sale_order confermati SELECT sal.opportunity_id, sal.user_id, sal.state, sal.invoice_status, SUM(COALESCE(sal.amount_untaxed, 0)) AS ordinato FROM sale_order sal WHERE COALESCE(sal.amount_untaxed, 0) > 10 AND COALESCE(sal.opportunity_id, 0) > 0 AND sal.state = 'sale' GROUP BY sal.opportunity_id, sal.user_id, sal.state, sal.invoice_status )
-- ============================================================ -- Branch 1 — un record per ogni lead/opportunità -- ============================================================ SELECT 1 AS x_lead_totali,
-- Dimensioni marketing (QS2) br.name AS x_brand, ag.name AS x_agenzia, cl.qs2_initiative AS x_iniziativa, ad.name AS x_inserzione, ad.platform AS x_piattaforma, ad.media_type AS x_tipo_media, ad.platform_ref AS x_ad_platform_ref,
-- Dimensioni UTM uc.name AS x_campagna, us.name AS x_origine, um.name AS x_mezzo,
-- Date cl.create_date AS x_data_acquisizione, DATE_TRUNC('month', cl.create_date) AS x_mese, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM cl.create_date)::integer AS x_anno, cl.date_closed AS x_data_chiusura,
-- Geolocalizzazione provs.name AS x_provincia, cl.city AS x_citta,
-- Anagrafica lead (sanitizzata) regexp_replace(COALESCE(cl.name, ''), '[^a-zA-Z0-9 ]', '', 'g') AS x_nome_lead, cl.email_from AS x_email, cl.phone AS x_telefono,
-- Venditore / Team (crm_team.name è jsonb translatable) rp.name AS x_venditore, COALESCE(st.name->>'it_IT', st.name->>'en_US') AS x_team,
-- Fase / Stato (crm_stage.name è jsonb translatable) COALESCE(cs.name->>'it_IT', cs.name->>'en_US') AS x_fase, cs.is_won AS x_is_won, cs.sequence AS x_fase_sequenza, cl.won_status AS x_won_status, CASE WHEN cl.won_status = 'won' THEN 'Vinto' WHEN cl.won_status = 'lost' THEN 'Perso' ELSE 'In corso' END AS x_stato_descrittivo,
-- Motivo perdita (crm_lost_reason.name è jsonb translatable) COALESCE(clr.name->>'it_IT', clr.name->>'en_US') AS x_motivo_perdita,
-- Funnel (contatori) CASE WHEN cl.won_status = 'won' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS x_lead_vinti, CASE WHEN cl.won_status = 'lost' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS x_lead_persi, CASE WHEN cl.won_status NOT IN ('won', 'lost') AND cl.active = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS x_lead_aperti,
-- Lavorabilità: pattern ILIKE sul nome del motivo di perdita -- (indipendente da ID specifici del DB, ridurre falsi positivi/negativi -- aggiungendo/togliendo pattern in base ai motivi configurati). CASE WHEN COALESCE(clr.name->>'it_IT', clr.name->>'en_US') ILIKE '%non lavorabile%' OR COALESCE(clr.name->>'it_IT', clr.name->>'en_US') ILIKE '%inutile%' OR COALESCE(clr.name->>'it_IT', clr.name->>'en_US') ILIKE '%spam%' OR COALESCE(clr.name->>'it_IT', clr.name->>'en_US') ILIKE '%duplicat%' OR COALESCE(clr.name->>'it_IT', clr.name->>'en_US') ILIKE '%numero errat%' OR COALESCE(clr.name->>'it_IT', clr.name->>'en_US') ILIKE '%test%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS x_non_lavorabile, CASE WHEN cl.won_status = 'won' THEN 1 WHEN COALESCE(clr.name->>'it_IT', clr.name->>'en_US') ILIKE '%non lavorabile%' OR COALESCE(clr.name->>'it_IT', clr.name->>'en_US') ILIKE '%inutile%' OR COALESCE(clr.name->>'it_IT', clr.name->>'en_US') ILIKE '%spam%' OR COALESCE(clr.name->>'it_IT', clr.name->>'en_US') ILIKE '%duplicat%' OR COALESCE(clr.name->>'it_IT', clr.name->>'en_US') ILIKE '%numero errat%' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS x_lavorabile,
-- Budget (dal piano media) mp.cost AS x_budget, mp.impressions AS x_impressions, mp.clicks AS x_clicks, mp.month AS x_mese_pianificato, mp.year AS x_anno_pianificato, mp.cpl AS x_cpl_pianificato, mp.roas AS x_roas_pianificato,
-- Revenue cl.expected_revenue AS x_ricavo_atteso, CASE WHEN cl.won_status = 'won' THEN cl.expected_revenue ELSE 0 END AS x_ricavo_vinto,
-- Vendite reali (da sale_order) COALESCE(of.ordinato, 0) AS x_ordinato, CASE WHEN of.invoice_status = 'invoiced' THEN COALESCE(of.ordinato, 0) ELSE 0 END AS x_fatturato
FROM crm_lead cl LEFT JOIN crm_stage cs ON cs.id = cl.stage_id LEFT JOIN crm_lost_reason clr ON clr.id = cl.lost_reason_id LEFT JOIN utm_source us ON us.id = cl.source_id LEFT JOIN utm_medium um ON um.id = cl.medium_id LEFT JOIN utm_campaign uc ON uc.id = cl.campaign_id LEFT JOIN qs2_brand br ON br.id = cl.qs2_brand_id LEFT JOIN qs2_agency ag ON ag.id = cl.qs2_agency_id LEFT JOIN qs2_ad ad ON ad.id = cl.qs2_ad_id LEFT JOIN qs2_media_plan mp ON mp.id = cl.qs2_media_plan_id LEFT JOIN crm_team st ON st.id = cl.team_id LEFT JOIN res_users ru ON ru.id = cl.user_id LEFT JOIN res_partner rp ON rp.id = ru.partner_id LEFT JOIN res_country_state provs ON provs.id = cl.state_id LEFT JOIN OrdFatt of ON of.opportunity_id = cl.id WHERE cl.type IN ('lead', 'opportunity')
UNION ALL
-- ============================================================ -- Branch 2 — piani media senza lead (budget speso senza ritorno) -- ============================================================ SELECT 0 AS x_lead_totali,
br.name AS x_brand, NULL AS x_agenzia, NULL AS x_iniziativa, NULL AS x_inserzione, NULL AS x_piattaforma, NULL AS x_tipo_media, NULL AS x_ad_platform_ref,
uc.name AS x_campagna, us.name AS x_origine, um.name AS x_mezzo,
-- Data fittizia: 2° giorno del mese del piano media (varchar -> integer cast) TO_DATE(mp.year || '-' || mp.month || '-02', 'YYYY-MM-DD')::timestamp AS x_data_acquisizione, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_DATE(mp.year || '-' || mp.month || '-02', 'YYYY-MM-DD'))::timestamp AS x_mese, mp.year::integer AS x_anno, NULL::timestamp AS x_data_chiusura,
NULL AS x_provincia, NULL AS x_citta,
'(Senza lead)' AS x_nome_lead, NULL AS x_email, NULL AS x_telefono,
NULL AS x_venditore, NULL AS x_team,
'(N/D)' AS x_fase, FALSE AS x_is_won, NULL::integer AS x_fase_sequenza, NULL AS x_won_status, 'Budget non utilizzato' AS x_stato_descrittivo, NULL AS x_motivo_perdita,
0 AS x_lead_vinti, 0 AS x_lead_persi, 0 AS x_lead_aperti, 0 AS x_non_lavorabile, 0 AS x_lavorabile,
mp.cost AS x_budget, mp.impressions AS x_impressions, mp.clicks AS x_clicks, mp.month AS x_mese_pianificato, mp.year AS x_anno_pianificato, mp.cpl AS x_cpl_pianificato, mp.roas AS x_roas_pianificato,
0::numeric AS x_ricavo_atteso, 0::numeric AS x_ricavo_vinto, 0::numeric AS x_ordinato, 0::numeric AS x_fatturato
FROM qs2_media_plan mp LEFT JOIN qs2_brand br ON br.id = mp.brand_id LEFT JOIN utm_source us ON us.id = mp.source_id LEFT JOIN utm_medium um ON um.id = mp.medium_id LEFT JOIN utm_campaign uc ON uc.id = mp.campaign_id WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM crm_lead cl WHERE cl.qs2_media_plan_id = mp.id )

SELECT cl.create_date AS x_data_creazione, cl.date_closed AS x_data_chiusura, DATE_TRUNC('month', cl.create_date) AS x_mese_creazione, DATE_TRUNC('month', cl.date_closed) AS x_mese_chiusura, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM cl.create_date)::integer AS x_anno_creazione, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM cl.date_closed)::integer AS x_anno_chiusura, cl.name AS x_nome, -- jsonb translatable → fallback it_IT → en_US COALESCE(cs.name->>'it_IT', cs.name->>'en_US') AS x_fase, cs.is_won AS x_vinto, cl.active AS x_attivo, rp.name AS x_venditore, COALESCE(st.name->>'it_IT', st.name->>'en_US') AS x_team, us.name AS x_origine, uc.name AS x_campagna, br.name AS x_brand, cl.expected_revenue AS x_ricavo_atteso, CASE WHEN cs.is_won = true THEN cl.expected_revenue ELSE 0 END AS x_fatturato, CASE WHEN cs.is_won = true THEN 'Vinto' WHEN cl.active = false THEN 'Perso' ELSE 'In corso' END AS x_esito, CASE WHEN cl.date_closed IS NOT NULL AND cl.create_date IS NOT NULL THEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM cl.date_closed - cl.create_date)::integer ELSE NULL END AS x_giorni_chiusura, 1 AS x_conteggio, CASE WHEN cs.is_won = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS x_vendite_chiuse, CASE WHEN cl.active = false AND cs.is_won = false THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS x_vendite_perse FROM crm_lead cl LEFT JOIN crm_stage cs ON cs.id = cl.stage_id LEFT JOIN crm_team st ON st.id = cl.team_id LEFT JOIN res_users ru ON ru.id = cl.user_id LEFT JOIN res_partner rp ON rp.id = ru.partner_id LEFT JOIN utm_source us ON us.id = cl.source_id LEFT JOIN utm_campaign uc ON uc.id = cl.campaign_id LEFT JOIN qs2_brand br ON br.id = cl.qs2_brand_id WHERE cl.type = 'opportunity'
